# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated for the `e2e-tests` workspace.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level and component-level architecture diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Declared dependency grouping and compatibility notes.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - API endpoints, communication patterns, and service sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence/data-layer assessment for the workspace scope.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, runtime settings, and versions.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Primary validation workflows and business rules.
